summary_brief: 2026年5月16日，AI Agent生态从"架构收编期"（May 15的TodoWrite→Task大Breaking Change）转入"工具链深化期"。今日最大新节点是Vercel AI SDK单日发布30+框架适配版本（React/Vue/Svelte/Angular/RSC等），标志其成为横跨全前端生态的AI基础设施层；gptme从昨日subagent角色系统延伸至headless自动化可编程组件（JSONL输出/+resume队列），CLI工具从"交互辅助"向"可集成组件"的质变正在形成；cline多维度工程改进（plugin加载机制/上下文预算/monorepo CI）则代表头部开源Agent工具链进入精细化工程阶段。活跃信号约50条，高影响比约16%，低于昨日50%，是May 6-16高位活跃周期的自然延续而非新转折点，但叙事重心已从"SDK架构升级"（May 6-15）切换为"工具链工程深化"。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 上下文管理能力系统性增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同时优化 token 预算预测和消息压缩机制，表明行业正在从「粗放式上下文使用」转向「精细化成本控制」，这对降低 AI 应用使用成本至关重要

engineering_signals.title: CLI 工具自动化集成能力成为竞争焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 通过文档化 JSONL 输出和 --resume 功能正式支持 headless 自动化场景，配合排队提示和多端协作能力，CLI 工具正从「交互式辅助」向「可编程组件」演进

engineering_signals.title: Vercel AI SDK 全框架覆盖战略持续推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 单日发布 30+ 个 AI SDK 版本，覆盖 React、Vue、Svelte、Angular、RSC 等所有主流前端框架，AI SDK 正成为 Web 开发的基础设施层

engineering_signals.title: GitHub Actions 安全加固成为工程规范
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 项目将 workflow 输入变量迁移到 env: 块以防止注入攻击，这符合 GitHub 官方安全指南，随着 AI 工具频繁操作 CI/CD，此安全实践将更为重要

engineering_signals.title: Monorepo 支持和 CI 成本优化成为工作流改进重点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: cline 通过路径过滤减少不必要的 CI 任务触发，同时重构工作流命名以支持 monorepo 布局，这两个方向共同指向大规模项目的工程效率优化

engineering_signals.title: 代码索引能力向脚本语言扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: aider 添加 Bash/Shell 脚本的 tree-sitter 支持，使仓库地图能够索引 .sh、.bash、.zsh 文件，填补了代码理解能力的覆盖空白

engineering_signals.title: AI 插件生态向垂直领域延伸
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Carta Cap Table 插件扩展 Claude 的财务分析能力，支持股权结构表、SAFE 协议、409A 估值等企业融资场景，AI 插件正从通用能力向行业解决方案深化

engineering_signals.title: Plugin 加载机制统一与可发现性改进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 修复生产环境 plugin tools 在 Settings 和 CLI 中缺失的问题，通过统一 sandbox-backed 加载逻辑消除进程内路径分歧，这是提升 AI Agent 工具生态可靠性的关键

releases.summary:
- Improve light theme TUI colors so chat, status bar, tool output, and syntax highlighting render with better contrast on light terminals.
- Fix plugin tools failing in the production npm build by bundling the SDK deps plugins import at runtime.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/cli-v3.0.3...cli-v3.0.4

key_changes: 修复生产环境 npm 构建中插件工具无法正常加载运行的问题

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added plugin dependency enforcement: `claude plugin disable` now refuses when another enabled plugin depends on the target (with a copy-pasteable disable-chain hint), and `claude plugin enable` force-enables transitive dependencies
- Added projected context cost (per-turn and per-invocation token estimates) to the `/plugin` marketplace browse pane
- Added `worktree.bgIsolation: "none"` setting to let background sessions edit the working copy directly without `EnterWorktree`, for repos where worktrees are impractical
- PowerShell tool now passes `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass`. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY=1`
- Background sessions now preserve the model and effort level you set after waking from idle
- Shift+Tab in attached agent sessions now includes auto mode in the cycle
- Fixed a corrupt `.credentials.json` with a non-array `scopes` value hanging the CLI on startup or silently aborting OAuth token refresh
- Fixed right-click paste in `claude agents` on Windows Terminal and WSL
- Fixed stop hooks that block repeatedly looping forever — the turn now ends with a warning after 8 consecutive blocks (override via `CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP`)
- Fixed Esc/Ctrl+C not cancelling a pending `/loop` wakeup while Claude is idle between iterations
- Fixed `/goal` evaluator firing while background shells or delegated subagents are still running
- Fixed `NO_COLOR`/`FORCE_COLOR` in settings.json `env` stripping Claude Code's own UI colors — they now apply to subprocesses only
- Fixed agent view spawning repeated PowerShell processes on Windows when listing sessions
- Fixed `/bg` without a prompt sending "continue" to the forked session — the fork now waits for input
- Fixed `--agent <name>` not finding plugin-contributed agents without the `plugin:` prefix
- Fixed deleting a session from agent view not removing its transcript file
- Fixed stale-fragment rendering when scrolling in attached background sessions on Windows Terminal
- Fixed background agents false-positive worker-stall detection storm after host sleep or macOS App Nap
- Fixed 5xx error messages pointing at status.claude.com instead of naming the configured gateway or cloud provider
- The PowerShell tool is now enabled by default on Windows for Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry users. Opt out with `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=0`.
- `claude agents` now accepts `--add-dir`, `--settings`, `--mcp-config`, and `--plugin-dir` and applies them to the dashboard and to background sessions dispatched from it
- `claude agents` accepts `--permission-mode`, `--model`, `--effort`, and `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to set defaults for sessions dispatched from the view
- `claude --bg --dangerously-skip-permissions` now persists across retire→wake
- Fixed background sessions silently capturing IDE file references into the warm spare's input, which caused the reference to be prepended to the next prompt dispatched from `claude agents`
- Worktree cleanup no longer falls back to `rm -rf` when `git worktree remove` fails, preventing loss of gitignored or in-progress files
- Fixed background-job sessions on macOS getting "Operation not permitted" errors when reading files under `~/Documents`, `~/Desktop`, or `~/Downloads`, even with Full Disk Access granted.
- `/bg` now preserves `--mcp-config`, `--settings`, `--add-dir`, `--plugin-dir`, and `--strict-mcp-config`, so backgrounded sessions keep their MCP servers and settings across respawn.
- Background sessions launched from `claude agents` now honor `permissions.defaultMode` from settings.json (was previously overridden to auto mode)
- Fixed: on Windows, pressing ← in `claude agents` while a response was streaming could leave the agents list unresponsive to all input
- `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--fallback-model`, so backgrounded workers degrade to the fallback model on overload instead of hard-failing.
- `/bg` and `←`-detach now preserve `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`, so the forked worker keeps bypass-permissions available in its Shift+Tab cycle.
- Fixed: background daemon spawn now falls back to the running binary when the `~/.local/bin/claude` launcher is missing or non-executable
- Fixed `claude agents --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` defaulting dispatched sessions to bypass mode instead of making it available in the permission cycle

key_changes: 新增插件依赖强制执行机制：禁用有依赖的插件时提供禁用链提示，启用插件时强制启用传递依赖
新增上下文成本预估功能：/plugin 市场面板显示每轮和每次调用的 token 消耗预估
新增 worktree.bgIsolation: none 设置，允许后台会话直接编辑工作副本
修复多个稳定性问题：credentials.json 损坏、停止钩子死循环、/loop 唤醒取消、/goal 提前触发等
PowerShell 工具默认传递 -ExecutionPolicy Bypass（可通过环境变量禁用）
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2.1.143 版本主要带来了插件依赖强制执行机制和上下文成本预估功能两大亮点，同时修复了大量稳定性问题包括 credentials.json 损坏导致的启动挂起、停止钩子死循环、后台 shell 运行期间 /goal 提前触发等。PowerShell 工具行为有轻微变化，默认传递 -ExecutionPolicy Bypass 但可通过环境变量禁用。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### Breaking

- **Breaking:** MCP servers now connect in the background by default; sessions start immediately and slow servers report `status: "pending"` in `init` until ready. Set `MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0` to restore the old behavior of waiting up to 5s before the first query, or mark a server `alwaysLoad: true` to require it in turn 1.
- **Breaking:** Headless and SDK sessions now use Task tools (`TaskCreate` / `TaskUpdate` / `TaskGet` / `TaskList`) instead of `TodoWrite`. Tool consumers should accumulate by task ID instead of replacing a snapshot list.

### New Features

- **`EffortLevel` type export**: Added a public `EffortLevel` type alias for Claude effort string levels (`"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`, `"max"`, `"xhigh"`) and exported it from the package root, making it available for downstream SDK wrappers and type annotations (#951)

### Bug Fixes

- **Stderr callback isolation**: Fixed an issue where a user-provided `stderr` callback that raises an exception would silently terminate the stderr reader loop, dropping all subsequent stderr lines for the rest of the session. Exceptions are now caught per-line so a failing callback does not prevent delivery of later lines (#932)
- **CancelledError in eager-flush done callback**: Fixed noisy `Exception in callback` log messages on shutdown when pending eager-flush tasks were cancelled. The done callback now gracefully handles `CancelledError` instead of unconditionally calling `Task.exception()` (#931)
- **Tighter `permission_suggestions` type**: Replaced `list[Any] | None` with `list[dict[str, Any]] | None` on `SDKControlPermissionRequest.permission_suggestions`, enabling proper type-checking on consumers of that field (#955)

### Documentation

- Clarified that `hooks` dispatch for a given event is concurrent (all matchers fire in parallel), not sequential, preventing incorrect assumptions about ordering-dependent hooks like rate limiters gating subsequent hooks (#956)

### Internal/Other Changes

- Bumped `mcp` dependency lower bound to `>=1.23.0` to address GHSA-9h52-p55h-vw2f (CVE-2025-66416), which disables DNS rebinding protection by default in older versions (#927)
- Stabilized eager-flush transcript mirror tests with deterministic wait helpers instead of fixed `asyncio.sleep(0)` yields (#933)
- Updated bundled Claude CLI to version 2.1.142

---

**PyPI:** https://pypi.org/project/claude-agent-sdk/0.2.82/

```bash
pip install claude-agent-sdk==0.2.82
```

key_changes: 【Breaking】MCP 服务器默认后台连接，慢速服务器报告 pending 状态，可通过 MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=0 恢复旧行为
【Breaking】Headless 和 SDK 会话改用 Task tools（TaskCreate/TaskUpdate/TaskGet/TaskList）替代 TodoWrite
新增 EffortLevel 类型导出，支持 low/medium/high/max/xhigh 等级别标注
修复 stderr 回调异常导致后续行丢失的问题，异常现按行隔离处理
修复 shutdown 时 CancelledError 导致的大量异常日志问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.2.82 版本包含两项重大 Breaking Changes：MCP 服务器连接行为从阻塞改为后台异步，SDK 会话改用 Task tools 替代 TodoWrite。此外还导出了 EffortLevel 类型供下游使用，并修复了 stderr 回调异常隔离和 CancelledError 处理两个问题。

# 2026.5.15 (v0.8.0)

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/acpx/v/0.8.0
registry tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/acpx/-/acpx-0.8.0.tgz
integrity: sha512-mI8ma3sDz8QfI2c40iiOAQ3iklpdv0XB7YFieOIcZZWw8dBTGsbFn4qqgbKQjDBX8S/yIWiKvmqi5j/L8c2kUQ==
published: 2026-05-15T15:51:32.704Z
release CI: https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/actions/runs/25927300574
commit: https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/commit/994fc6c9cf1384950dd3e5a9175d7c2a134eb4be

## Changelog

### Changes

- Runtime/embedding: add an optional `onPermissionRequest` callback to `AcpRuntimeOptions` and `AcpClientOptions` so embedders can intercept ACP per-call permission requests with their own UI. Returning a decision short-circuits the mode-based resolver; returning `undefined` falls through to it, leaving CLI behavior unchanged. Thanks @DaniAkash.
- Runtime/embedding: `AcpRuntime.ensureSession` now accepts `sessionOptions` (`systemPrompt`, `model`, `allowedTools`, `maxTurns`) for fresh sessions, threading the values into `_meta.systemPrompt` (and `_meta.claudeCode.options.*`) on the underlying `session/new` request and persisting them onto the new record. Reusing an existing persistent record continues to ignore `sessionOptions` since system prompts are fixed at `newSession` time. `SessionAgentOptions` and `SystemPromptOption` are now re-exported from `acpx/runtime`. Thanks @DaniAkash.
- Runtime/embedding: surface advertised models on `AcpRuntimeStatus.models` so embedders can build model pickers without reaching into private session records. Thanks @DaniAkash.
- CLI/permissions: add `--permission-policy`/`--policy` for per-tool ACP permission rules with `autoApprove`, `autoDeny`, `escalate`, and `defaultAction`; non-interactive escalations now surface structured tool name/input metadata for orchestrators.

### Breaking

### Fixes

- Runtime/embedding: preserve structured ACP `tool_call_update` details on public runtime events, including content, output, locations, kind, and raw payload fields, so embedders can display live tool progress. (#306) Thanks @joeia26.
- CLI/sessions: checkpoint live assistant and tool updates while prompt turns are still running, so `sessions read` and `sessions history` can show in-flight progress instead of only the submitted prompt. (#314) Thanks @AndroidPoet.
- Flows: keep external TypeScript flow modules that import `acpx/flows` compatible with current `tsx` loader behavior.
- Terminal: run no-argument `terminal/create` command lines so agents that send an unsplit command do not fail with `ENOENT`. Thanks @xdjyxu.
- CLI/config: accept command-local `--format` on `config show` and `config init`.
- CLI/sessions: accept the documented `-s` shorthand on `sessions new` and `sessions ensure`.
- Replay viewer: add help output for `pnpm viewer --help` without starting a server.
- Replay viewer: make `pnpm viewer status` and `pnpm viewer stop` dispatch to the requested command instead of always prepending `start`.
- Package: keep `npm pack --json` output parseable by running the prepack build quietly.
- CLI/output: exit cleanly on broken pipes so common pipelines such as `acpx ... | grep -q ...` do not crash with an unhandled `EPIPE`.
- Tooling: document the current Node.js 22.13+ and pnpm 10.33.2 floor.
- Tooling/docs: document npm-based pnpm bootstrap for clean Node 22.13 setups with stale Corepack signing keys.
- Docs/auth: document the supported `authPolicy` values and ACP credential selection behavior.
- Docs/skills: make the quick setup skill-install command noninteractive and route unsupported harnesses to the reference URL.
- CLI/queue: honor per-request `--prompt-retries` when sending a prompt to an already-warm persistent queue owner.
- Runtime/embedding: reject unsupported advertised config option keys before forwarding them to adapters, and map generic `thinking` controls to advertised `effort` options when available. (#293)

key_changes: 新增 `onPermissionRequest` 回调函数，支持嵌入器拦截 ACP 权限请求
`AcpRuntime.ensureSession` 新增 `sessionOptions` 参数，支持 systemPrompt、model、allowedTools、maxTurns 配置
在 `AcpRuntimeStatus.models` 上暴露广告模型，便于嵌入器构建模型选择器
新增 `--permission-policy`/`--policy` CLI 选项，支持 per-tool ACP 权限策略配置（autoApprove、autoDeny、escalate、defaultAction）
修复 `tool_call_update` 事件的结构化细节在公共运行时事件上丢失的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.8.0 版本主要增强了 ACP 运行时嵌入能力和权限管理功能。新增了 `onPermissionRequest` 回调机制，让嵌入器可以自定义权限请求 UI；同时改进了 `ensureSession` 方法，支持传入 session 配置参数；此外还新增了 `--permission-policy` CLI 选项用于精细的权限策略管理。该版本还修复了 `tool_call_update` 事件细节丢失的问题，提升了事件数据的完整性。

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
### Minor Changes

-   9aead7a: Add `vercel connect detach` to detach a Vercel project from a connector via `DELETE /v1/connect/connectors/:id/projects/:projectId`. Mirrors `vercel connect attach` and matches the project-scope "Disconnect" button in the dashboard.

    Add `--triggers`, `--trigger-branch`, and `--trigger-path` flags to `vercel connect attach`. When `--triggers` is set, the project is also registered as a trigger destination on the connector via `PATCH /v1/connect/connectors/:id/trigger-destinations` so verified webhooks get forwarded to it. Requires the connector to support triggers; warns if the connector was created without `triggers.enabled`.

    Both features gated behind the existing `FF_CONNEX_ENABLED` flag.

-   b1db109: Enable `vercel connect` by default and mark it as beta in `--help`. The command was previously gated behind the internal `FF_CONNEX_ENABLED` env var; it is now available out of the box and surfaces in `vercel --help` as `connect [cmd] Manage connectors [beta]`. The subcommand description also reads `Manage connectors (Beta)`.

    Fix `vercel connect open` to link to the renamed `/~/connect/` dashboard route directly instead of relying on the legacy `/~/connex/` → `/~/connect/` 308 redirect.

-   e8deaa1: Rename `vercel connex` command to `vercel connect`. The command remains gated behind the existing `FF_CONNEX_ENABLED` flag.

-   cc30efd: Refresh the `vc` setup-and-link flow and post-deploy output for clarity and visual consistency.

    **Prompt copy**

    -   `Want to modify these settings?` → `Customize settings?`.
    -   `Which scope should contain your project?` → `Which team?`. Matches dashboard + docs vocabulary.
    -   `What's your project's name?` → `Name?`. The directory-derived default still renders inline via the inquirer default.
    -   `Loading scopes…` spinner → `Loading teams…`.

    **Flow changes**

    -   Removed the `Set up and deploy "/path"?` confirmation prompt. Intent is implied by running `vc`; the path is surfaced as a status line (`  Set up "/path"`) and Ctrl-C remains the escape hatch.
    -   The `In which directory is your code located?` prompt now fires when (a) the current directory is a workspace (monorepo with multiple packages), (b) the user explicitly chose "Choose a different root directory" via the inferred-services picker, **or (c) framework detection at the root finds nothing — covers nested-monolith layouts like `repo/app/package.json` where the app lives in a subdir.** Single-app projects with a framework detected at the root still default the root to `.` and skip the prompt.

    **Output format**

    -   `Auto-detected Project Settings for X` line replaced with a single bold `Detected X (Build Command: …, Output Directory: …)` line. Title Case labels match the checkbox panel below. Only `Detected` is bold; framework name and parens render plain/dim.
    -   Introduced a new aligned-label format for status output via the `printAlignedLabel` helper (12-char bold label column, value column at terminal column 14). Applied to `Linked` / `Inspect` / `Production` / `Preview` / `Aliased` / `Added` rows.
    -   `vc redeploy` output now uses the same aligned-label format as `vc deploy` — `Inspect` / `Production` / `Preview` / `Aliased` rows are consistent across both commands. No more emoji-prefix / aligned-label mixing in the same session.
    -   `vc link --repo` info messages (`No Projects are linked…`, `Found N Project(s) linked…`, `Detected N new Project(s)…`, `Created new Project: …`) dropped the gray `> ` prefix and now use the 2-space indent that matches the rest of the link/setup flow.
    -   Path-in-prompt for `vc link --repo` confirm message uses `chalk.dim` instead of `chalk.cyan` — paths are not URLs, so dim is the correct treatment per the color rules (cyan reserved for URLs).
    -   Introduced a "gutter" semantic system: column 0 is reserved for semantic glyphs. `▲` marks Production deploys (`▲ Production  URL`) and breaks out of the indent — bookending the session with the `▲` brand mark at the top. Preview deploys stay in-column without the triangle.
    -   Added a terminal `✓ Ready in Xs` line at deploy completion (green ✓ at column 0, bold `Ready`, dim duration). Skipped when `--no-wait` is set and the deployment hasn't reached READY yet.
    -   Dropped the emoji prefixes (`🔗`, `🔍`, `⏳`) on Linked / Inspect / Production rows (across both `vc deploy` and `vc redeploy`).
    -   Dropped the `Building: ` prefix from the build-logs spinner. Each streamed log line is shown verbatim instead of `Building: <line>`.
    -   Dropped the `(created .vercel and added it to .gitignore)` parenthetical from `Linked` — `git status` surfaces it on demand.
    -   Dropped the `[Xs]` timing suffix from URL lines. URLs are results, not operations — timing belongs on the build / ready signal.

    **Defensive fix**

    -   `services-setup.ts` now uses an optional chain on `detectServicesResult.resolved?.source`. This was crashing the setup flow before any prompts could fire when no services were detected (common for empty or simple fixtures).

    **New helper**

    -   `packages/cli/src/util/output/print-aligned-label.ts` exports `printAlignedLabel(label, value, options?: { gutter?: string })` and the `ALIGNED_LABEL_WIDTH` constant (12). Used by every aligned-row print site.

signals.topic: GenerativeModelStore incremental fetch cursor regresses, defeating cloud egress-savings daemon purpose
signals.summary: The _last_fetch_id cursor in GenerativeModelStore is updated to the max ID of each delta batch rather than a monotonic high-water mark. When an incremental fetch returns rows with a max ID lower than the prior high-water mark, the cursor regresses, causing the next poll to re-fetch all rows between the new cursor and the true global max, silently breaking the daemon's cost-reduction purpose in cloud environments.
signals.review_reason: Root cause is precisely identified (non-monotonic cursor update). Reproduced with step-by-step walkthrough. Impact is quantified: any incremental fetch where the max id is below the prior high-water mark triggers a full re-pull, silently breaking the cost-reduction guarantee of the daemon in cloud environments. No data loss but cost impact is direct.

signals.topic: Agent produces no usable output or hallucinates unrelated tasks, wasting user tokens and compute
signals.summary: Agents either produce zero files despite detailed planning (only generating verbal 'accompaniment' responses), or hallucinate and start working on entirely unrelated projects after correctly completing an assigned task, wasting tens of turns and significant token budget.
aliases: Token waste due to agent non-delivery
signals.review_reason: Two users report the agent failing to deliver any usable software output — one never writes files at all over 10 days despite consuming tokens, the other starts hallucinating unrelated tasks mid-session. Both represent severe token/compute waste with zero productive outcome, a core experience failure.

source_issues.title: (Agent produces no files / 'accompaniment responses' only)
source_issues.evidence: Over 10 days the agent produced detailed plans and verbal progress reports but never wrote a single file to the workspace, wasting all token budget with no usable output.

source_issues.title: Agent hallucinates unrelated project after completing task
source_issues.evidence: After correctly completing the assigned task, the agent spontaneously starts building an entirely unrelated 3D Robotic Arm project, wasting 59 turns on 1 file and significant token/compute resources.

signals.topic: Enterprise/SaaS product tiers silently disable or misload critical features users expect to work
signals.summary: SaaS users cannot access LLM Profiles feature because the settings page redirects and disables the feature for org-scoped accounts. Enterprise users find that skills from `.agents` repositories (the documented standard) fail to load, with only the legacy `.openhands` repo name working.
signals.review_reason: Two distinct issues affecting paid/Enterprise tiers: SaaS users cannot access a core configuration feature (LLM Profiles), and Enterprise skills loading fails for the documented naming convention (.agents). Both represent key feature unavailability for paying customers.

source_issues.title: Enable LLM Profiles for SaaS (Org-Level Storage)
source_issues.evidence: SaaS users are blocked from accessing LLM Profiles because /settings redirects to /settings/org-defaults and LlmSettingsScreen disables profiles when scope='org'.

source_issues.title: OpenHands Enterprise not loading skills from `.agents` repos
source_issues.evidence: Enterprise is not loading Org or User skills from .agents repository despite it being the documented naming convention. Only .openhands works. This is a customer-support filed bug with enterprise impact.

signals.topic: Platform-specific encoding failures and UI text rendering bugs on Windows and ACP platform
signals.summary: Windows users encounter silent log-write failures for non-ASCII characters (emoji) causing empty JSON files. ACP platform users see spaces incorrectly dropped before commands in action titles, rendering UI text malformed.
signals.review_reason: Two platform-specific issues: Windows users lose log data silently due to encoding failures, and ACP users see malformed UI text. Both are UX degradation issues that corrupt data or readability, warranting P2 for their scope.

source_issues.title: RemoteConversation log writer encoding fails on Windows
source_issues.evidence: On Windows, non-ASCII characters (emoji) in log writes trigger 'charmap' codec error, causing silent failures and empty .json files being created instead of actual log data.

source_issues.title: Trans component drops space before cmd in titles
source_issues.evidence: The i18n Trans component incorrectly renders action titles by dropping spaces before 'cmd', showing 'Runningcd /workspace' instead of 'Running cd /workspace' on the ACP platform.

signals.topic: Bitbucket provider authentication completely broken — deprecated App Passwords no longer work
signals.summary: The Bitbucket integration uses a deprecated App Passwords authentication format that Bitbucket has discontinued. Users attempting to connect Bitbucket repositories get authentication failures, blocking a core OpenHands use case of repository integration.
signals.review_reason: Single but high-confidence issue: the Bitbucket provider authentication is entirely broken due to Bitbucket deprecating App Passwords. The issue explicitly states all auth formats fail and this 'blocks a core use case of OpenHands (repo integration)'. High impact despite count=1 due to complete feature blockage.

source_issues.title: Bitbucket provider authentication broken (API tokens)
source_issues.evidence: Bitbucket App Passwords are deprecated and replaced with API tokens. OpenHands still relies on the old auth format. All attempted authentication formats fail. This directly blocks the core use case of integrating with Bitbucket repositories.

signals.review_reason: Two distinct external integration failures both raise BlockUnknownError, causing workflow execution to halt. The Ayrshare 403 breaks social media integration blocks; the header error represents a recurring error class that blocks internal service calls. Both are production-blocking runtime errors.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: Ayrshare API request failed (403): The Profile Key is invalid.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: Illegal header value b' a83749cd-ed79-40b9-87df-2cf9e276193d'

aliases: payment gateway not showing on production
razorpay vs stripe billing page bug

source_issues.title: Razorpay payment gateway not showing on production
source_issues.evidence: Database has paymentGateway='razorpay' but billing page always renders 'Continue to Stripe'; two bugs identified in backend settings route (wrong endpoint) and frontend API client (wrong path).

signals.topic: Large file serving is unreliable — generated images/files appear broken ~20% of page refreshes

source_issues.title: Serving Large Files to User is Flakey
source_issues.evidence: Files >500kb often show as broken in chat; on refresh ~20% chance of loading correctly each time. 6 comments, bug label, confirmed reproducible by refreshing 10 times on Nano Banana Pro generated images.

signals.topic: Builder execution data desync — 'Node not found' Sentry errors indicate frontend/backend version mismatch in production
signals.summary: Sentry captures recurring 'Node not found for execution data' errors in both production and development, indicating the frontend and backend are out of sync during graph execution, breaking the builder experience for affected users.
aliases: node not found for execution data
signals.review_reason: The 'This shouldn't happen and means that the frontend and backend are out of sync' error is captured by Sentry in production with replays, indicating active user impact across environments. This breaks the builder/graph execution workflow for affected sessions.

source_issues.title: Node not found for execution data: [object Object] This shouldn't happen and means that the frontend and backend are out of sync.
source_issues.evidence: Sentry issue BUILDER-3MQ captured across both prod and dev; message explicitly states 'frontend and backend are out of sync'; events and replays available in Sentry; bug labeled.

signals.topic: Mobile UI parity gaps and missing builder warnings degrade mobile user experience
signals.summary: Mobile users encounter a degraded CoPilot experience (different controls/layout vs desktop) and the graph builder silently renders without warning despite being non-functional on mobile, leaving users confused.
aliases: builder not optimized for mobile no warning
signals.review_reason: Mobile users get a degraded and inconsistent experience compared to desktop, and the builder silently fails without feedback, causing confusion. While not blocking core desktop flows, this is a real UX degradation for the mobile segment.

source_issues.title: Small mobile responsiveness pass: CoPilot parity + builder warning

signals.topic: Doc Context Provider crawls 0 documents for Angular documentation (outdated URL hardcoded)

While count=1 (single repo), the severity is high — a core feature (doc-as-context) is non-functional for a popular framework. The user provided concrete log evidence of 0 documents crawled.

source_issues.title: Angular Doc Context Provider Crawls Outdated URL
source_issues.evidence: User explicitly shows log output where Crawled 0 documents from 'https://angular.io/docs'. Angular.io/docs is archived content for Angular v17; current is v21 and active docs are at angular.dev. The doc context provider feature is entirely broken for Angular — no documents are indexed.

signals.topic: 群聊功能运行时调度错误导致对话不可用

signals.review_reason: 用户痛点明确：群聊主流程对话功能不可用。错误信息为运行时参数调度失败，属于主流程阻断性问题，虽 count=1 但用户影响证据清晰（群聊对话完全不可用，网关正常说明问题在业务层而非基础设施层），应保留为 P1。

source_issues.title: 群聊出现：Runtime dispatch to coder failed: error: too many arguments for 'agent'. Expected 0 arguments but got 8.
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确描述群聊不能正常对话，网关正常，属于主流程阻断场景。错误为运行时调度参数不匹配：期望 agent 接受 0 个参数但实际传入了 8 个参数。

signals.topic: AI聊天消息重复显示：用户发送单条任务消息后，ClawX反复渲染展示同一消息多次
signals.summary: 用户执行AI任务时，单次发送的消息被重复渲染显示多次，消息内容完全一致，导致界面信息混乱、用户困惑。此问题偶发但可复现，影响核心聊天交互体验。
signals.review_reason: 聊天消息重复渲染是明确的UI异常行为，导致用户在核心对话流程中产生信息混乱和困惑。虽然count=1，但错误表现直观（同一消息文本出现两次）、可复现（偶发），符合用户痛点定义中的'体验显著下降'。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: task message show many times
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确描述：'I send one message but clawx show my message again and again'，日志中同一消息文本出现两次，且带有不同工具调用计数，说明消息被重复渲染。

signals.topic: AI聊天框会话中途停止按钮异常恢复：任务执行中发送按钮提前恢复为默认状态，用户误以为会话已中断
signals.summary: 在AI执行长时间任务过程中，发送按钮错误地提前恢复到默认状态（而非保持停止按钮样式），导致用户误以为会话已中断，但实际任务可能仍在后台运行，造成严重困惑和体验损失。
signals.review_reason: 发送按钮状态错误是典型的UI状态管理缺陷，直接导致用户在核心任务执行流程中对会话状态产生误判（以为中断但实际未中断）。该问题阻断用户对任务进度的准确感知，属于'体验显著下降'，且有清晰的用户描述和预期/实际行为对比。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: AI聊天框，会话容易中断
source_issues.evidence: 用户明确描述：'AI聊天框总是大模型还没执行结束，发送按钮就回到了默认状态...感觉就是断掉了'，并指出预期行为应为'会话发送按钮只要会话没有中断就应该一直显示停止的样式'。问题导致用户无法准确判断任务真实状态。

signals.topic: /new和/reset命令在长对话后响应严重延迟，性能随消息数量持续劣化

signals.review_reason: 核心会话重置命令在长对话后出现严重性能劣化，相比原版有数量级差距（100-300ms vs 1-3s+），直接影响用户高频使用场景的流畅度，属于'体验显著下降'。用户提供了量化对比数据和初步根因分析，问题可复现且影响明确。

source_issues.title: [Performance] /new 命令响应慢，长对话后延迟明显

signals.summary: 用户在ClawX 0.41和0.42测试版中遭遇网关(Gateway)启动失败，导致应用核心功能无法使用，属于主流程阻断级别的严重问题。

signals.topic: tool_choice parameter not supported across multiple model providers, causing API errors
signals.summary: The tool_choice parameter causes 'not supported' errors on many model backends. Users cannot configure which tools to restrict LLM to, limiting a core feature.
signals.review_reason: tool_choice is a core agent feature for controlling which tools the LLM can use. When unsupported, users get API errors and cannot use this functionality at all. Count=2 (issues #1608 and #1516) confirms this is a recurring problem across providers, not an isolated incident. Feature was moved to milestone 2.0, indicating the current implementation is known to be broken.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: tool_choice参数支持的问题
source_issues.evidence: tool_choice parameter causes unsupported errors on multiple model backends. Screenshot shows API error. 2 comments on issue.

source_issues.title: feat(tool_choice): support the newest tool choice logic in anthropic chat model and openai chat model
source_issues.evidence: Feature request to extend tool_choice support for Anthropic/OpenAI latest response API, specifically for meta-tool 'reset_tools' feature. Closed as milestone: 2.0, indicating current implementation is incomplete.

signals.topic: ReActAgent thinking-only LLM response causes premature loop exit and empty user output
signals.summary: When LLM returns only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use), ReActAgent loop incorrectly exits, returning empty/thinking-only response to user.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is blocked: the agent's core reasoning-acting loop produces empty responses silently when using thinking-capable models. This is a critical failure in the agent's primary execution path, directly causing user-visible empty outputs without any error indication. Reproducible with specific model types (thinking-enabled Claude/Qwen), making it a clear structural defect.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: ReActAgent exits loop prematurely when LLM returns only thinking blocks (no text, no tool_use)
source_issues.evidence: ReActAgent loop exit condition at line 514 in _react_agent.py checks only for absence of tool_use. When model (Claude/Qwen with thinking enabled) returns thinking-only response, loop breaks and returns msg_reasoning containing no user-visible text, effectively producing empty output. Reproducible with Claude 3.5/4/Qwen thinking-enabled models. agentscope version 1.0.19 confirmed.

signals.topic: Formatter memory leak (deepcopy on every API call) causes Python OOM and API rejection cascade
signals.summary: TruncatedFormatterBase calls deepcopy(msgs) on every API call, causing unbounded memory growth in long conversations. Combined with content:null API rejection bug, creates infinite crash loop leading to Python OOM.
signals.review_reason: Causes main workflow failure through two compounding mechanisms: (1) Python OOM crash after ~50+ turns, completely terminating the agent process — no recovery possible; (2) API rejection cascade with related issues #1426/#1436 creating an infinite crash loop. Clearly a high-impact issue affecting the primary use case of running long multi-turn conversations.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Formatter memory leak and content:null API rejection cascade
source_issues.evidence: Three combined bugs: (A) deepcopy(msgs) on every TruncatedFormatterBase.format() call causes memory to grow from ~200MB to 3GB+ in long conversations, eventually OOM. (B) content:null sent to DeepSeek API causes 400 Bad Request (messages[N] content should be a string or list). (C) convert_tool_result_to_string crashes on None output. Related to #1426 (empty assistant turns on crash) and #1436 (open PR to fix it).

signals.topic: OpenAI Responses API not supported — 404 error when calling backends that only support Responses endpoint
signals.summary: OpenAIChatModel only calls /chat/completions endpoint. Users calling backends (e.g., local models, third-party providers) that only support OpenAI Responses API get 404 errors, making those backends completely unusable.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is blocked for users whose backend only exposes the Responses API. The agent cannot run at all — every API call immediately returns 404. This is a complete functional block for a specific but growing class of model backends (local servers, third-party providers). Priority P0 despite count=1 due to complete workflow blockage with explicit error traceback.

source_issues.title: [Bug]: 不支持openai Responses API
source_issues.evidence: OpenAIChatModel.__call__ uses client.chat.completions.create(), hardcoded to /chat/completions. Backends that only support Responses API (e.g., local model servers) return 404, making the agent completely unusable. Reproducible with any backend that exposes only Responses API. Stack trace shows openai.NotFoundError: 404 page not found. Version 1.0.17 confirmed.

signals.topic: OpenAIChatModel.__call__ drops critical SDK return fields (finish_reason, tool_calls, function_call, reasoning)
signals.summary: AgentScope's OpenAIChatModel wrapper does not expose critical response fields (finish_reason, tool_calls, function_call, reasoning) returned by the underlying OpenAI SDK, breaking upper-layer functionality that depends on these fields.
signals.review_reason: Key model response metadata is silently dropped, breaking upper-layer functionality. finish_reason is needed to detect agent stop conditions, tool_calls is needed for the agent's tool execution loop. This causes the agent to miss tool calls and misdetect response completion, directly degrading agent reliability in multi-turn conversations.

source_issues.title: [Feature]:agentscope封装的OpenAIChatModel.__call__方法中，漏掉了一些openai sdk会返回的参数
source_issues.evidence: OpenAIChatModel.__call__ returns ChatResponse without finish_reason, tool_calls, function_call, reasoning fields. The raw OpenAI SDK returns Choice with finish_reason='stop', tool_calls, function_call, and reasoning fields, but AgentScope's wrapper discards these. This breaks functionality that depends on finish_reason (to detect stop/continue) and tool_calls (agent tool execution). Reproducible with agentscope 1.0.18.

signals.topic: AGUI multimodal image inputs silently dropped before reaching Agent/Team
signals.summary: When AG-UI receives a multimodal user message with image parts (from CopilotKit), the image components are extracted and discarded before `agent.arun()` or `team.arun()` is called. Only text is passed through, making screenshots and image attachments completely invisible to the model. Users cannot use image inputs in AGUI-backed applications.
aliases: multimodal image stripped from AGUI messages
signals.review_reason: Core multimodal capability is silently broken in the AGUI integration path. User screenshots from CopilotKit are completely lost before reaching the model — not a degraded experience, but total failure of a supported feature. The silent nature (no error, no warning) makes this particularly dangerous as users may not realize their image context was never seen by the agent.

source_issues.title: [Bug] AGUI interface drops multimodal image inputs before calling Agent/Team
source_issues.evidence: extract_agui_user_input() only handles text parts (part.type=='text'), drops ImageInputContent parts entirely. agent.arun() and team.arun() are called without the images= parameter. Reproduction confirms body 'please inspect' is extracted but image URL https://example.com/screenshot.png is silently discarded.

signals.topic: Session I/O storage wrappers swallow all DB exceptions and return None, causing silent session data loss
signals.summary: Agent/Team storage layer functions (read_session, upsert_session) catch all Exception types and return None, making DB errors indistinguishable from 'session not found'. When a transient DB failure occurs, callers treat the None as 'no session' and create a brand-new empty session, silently discarding all prior chat history, tool call history, and session state with no error signal.
aliases: DB errors indistinguishable from session not found
session data silently discarded on DB error
signals.review_reason: Silent data loss with no error signal is a critical user pain point. Any transient database error (connection timeout, lock contention, brief unavailability) causes complete loss of all conversation history and session state. Users have no way to detect the loss because no exception is raised — the system silently creates a fresh empty session. This violates a fundamental expectation of stateful session management.

source_issues.title: Bug: session I/O wrappers in _storage.py swallow DB exceptions and return None, causing silent session data loss
source_issues.evidence: read_session catches Exception, logs warning, returns None. read_or_create_session sees None and creates new empty AgentSession, discarding all prior data. upsert_session failures are silently dropped — no error propagated, no retry, no signal to caller. Transient PostgreSQL errors (timeout, lock contention) trigger data loss.

signals.topic: Workflow cancellation ineffective during acontinue_run with external_execution tool
signals.summary: When a workflow step uses `external_execution=True` for its Agent tool, the workflow cancellation mechanism fails to stop execution during `acontinue_run`. The `araise_if_cancelled()` check is not invoked in the executor HITL code path, allowing cancelled runs to continue to completion and waste LLM resources.
aliases: cancellation check missing in executor HITL path
signals.review_reason: Cancellation is a core safety mechanism for long-running agent workflows. When it fails silently, users cannot stop runaway or unwanted executions, resulting in wasted LLM tokens and continued processing of inputs that should have been aborted. The issue is precisely reproducible with the provided MRE.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Workflow cancellation is ineffective during continue run
source_issues.evidence: MRE shows RunContentEvents continuing to stream after acancel_run is called when external_execution=True. Log shows 'Run marked for cancellation' but WorkflowCompletedEvent still fires. Issue author identified that araise_if_cancelled is not called in the executor HITL path in workflow.py line ~7354 and beyond.

signals.topic: Nested Team with HITL: top-level leader does not produce synthesis after acontinue_run
signals.summary: In nested Team hierarchies (Team → Team → Agent), after a member agent's HITL tool is approved and `acontinue_run` resumes, the top-level leader team does not re-invoke its LLM to produce a final synthesis message to the user. Only member-level AgentToolStarted/CompletedEvents fire, followed by TeamRunCompleted with no content. Users must use a 'team-as-tool' workaround instead of the natural member pattern.
aliases: nested team HITL leader synthesis missing
top-leader synthesis absent after nested resume
Team member results not appended in nested HITL path
signals.review_reason: This blocks a key architectural pattern for building multi-agent systems with human oversight. Users who structure their teams with nested sub-teams (a natural design) find that the top-level leader goes silent after HITL resume — the user never receives a confirmation that their approved action completed. The issue is precisely documented with a full MRE, root cause analysis, and a validated workaround.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Workflow cancellation is ineffective during continue run
source_issues.evidence: Full MRE provided showing event stream after resume: AgentToolStartedEvent + AgentToolCompletedEvent from member, then TeamRunCompletedEvent from top-leader with no TeamRunContentEvent. author provides two-part SDK fix: add team_id/team_name/member_responses to RunOutput dataclass, and fix _aroute_requirements_to_members_stream to always append member results.

source_issues.title: [Feature Request] Nested Team (Team → Team → Agent) with HITL: how to trigger top-level leader synthesis after acontinue_run?
source_issues.evidence: Complete nested team architecture described with full working Python MRE. Observed event stream shows TeamRunContentEvent never emitted from top-leader after HITL resume. Workaround validated (team-as-tool) but is architecturally inferior. author identifies RunOutput missing team_id/team_name/member_responses and _aroute_requirements_to_members_stream always taking the pause propagation branch without appending to member_results.

signals.topic: Langfuse traces missing for /continue endpoint, breaking observability of resumed runs
signals.summary: When resuming a paused agent run via the `/continue` endpoint after HITL approval, the continued execution completes successfully but emits zero Langfuse traces, spans, or generations. Token counts, cost data, and the full resumed model inference are invisible in Langfuse. This affects all HITL types (requires_confirmation, requires_user_input, external_execution) and makes cost tracking unreliable.
signals.review_reason: Observability gaps in agent runs directly impair debugging and cost management. When HITL resumes produce no traces, users cannot see what model was called, what tokens were consumed, or what tool executed after approval. This is a significant gap for production deployments relying on Langfuse for monitoring. The evidence includes a concrete MRE with curl commands and a Langfuse session screenshot.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Langfuse traces missing for `/runs/{run_id}/continue` endpoint
source_issues.evidence: MRE with curl commands shows initial /runs call produces a Langfuse trace but /continue call (which returns full SSE with tool calls and model response) produces zero traces. Session in Langfuse shows only 1 trace for a session with a paused and continued run. author notes token counts and cost data for resumed runs are invisible.

signals.topic: AI infinite thinking loop wastes API credits and prevents task completion
signals.summary: On complex problems, the AI repeatedly outputs identical reasoning steps verbatim (6+ times observed), even after acknowledging being stuck. The loop is non-breaking, wastes API tokens, and leaves tasks unfinished. Observed across multiple model families (GLM 5.1, Qwen 3.6 Plus Free) and appears in at least two separate issues from different reporters.
aliases: infinite thinking loop on complex tasks
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：AI 在复杂任务中进入不可跳出的死循环，导致任务永远无法完成，同时持续消耗 API 积分（金钱损失）。两条独立 issue 提供日志证据，且跨多模型族复现，置信度高。已由官方关闭确认。

source_issues.title: AI enters infinite thinking loop on complex problems across multiple models
source_issues.evidence: Identical thought block repeated 6+ times verbatim. AI acknowledges 'I got stuck in a loop' but immediately re-enters same loop. Logs provided showing exact repetition. Closed as duplicate of #27925.

source_issues.title: AI enters infinite thinking loop on complex problems across multiple models
source_issues.evidence: Same issue independently reported with identical log evidence. Thought block repeated 6+ times with zero changes. Affects GLM 5.1 and Qwen 3.6 Plus Free. Closed.

signals.topic: Tool schema [MaxDepth] placeholder leaks into API requests causing session-killing 400 errors
signals.summary: OpenCode sends unresolved [MaxDepth] placeholder strings in JSON Schema tool definitions instead of valid objects. This causes API 400 errors from strict proxies (OmniRoad, OpenRouter), and once [MaxDepth] enters the conversation history as literal string, the entire session becomes permanently dead — all subsequent requests fail.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用 + 主流程阻断：tool schema 中的占位符泄漏导致整个会话永久死亡（session is dead），且影响所有使用代理（OmniRoad/OpenRouter）的用户。详细日志和 payload 示例提供了强证据。

source_issues.title: [MaxDepth] placeholders leak into tool schemas — causes API 400 errors
source_issues.evidence: Detailed reproduction steps with request payload excerpts showing items: '[MaxDepth]' instead of valid JSON Schema. Impact section explains the cascade: placeholder enters messages[], next request triggers 400, ALL subsequent requests in the session fail permanently. 1 comment confirming.

signals.topic: Stream lifecycle race: late enqueue after cancellation crashes sidecar process
signals.summary: When a stream consumer/session is aborted or cancelled, upstream provider streams may still deliver late chunks. OpenCode bare controller.enqueue() calls throw ERR_INVALID_STATE, crashing the sidecar process. This is especially likely during aborted sessions, provider retry/fallback, client disconnects, and long-running streams — resulting in unexpected session death.
signals.review_reason: 进程崩溃导致会话意外死亡：late chunk 在 consumer cancel 后尝试写入已关闭的 stream controller，触发 ERR_INVALID_STATE，sidecar 进程终止，用户会话非正常结束。影响面覆盖多种触发场景（断连、重试、provider fallback），影响真实用户。

source_issues.title: Sidecar can crash on late stream enqueue after consumer cancellation
source_issues.evidence: Detailed root cause analysis with specific file locations and code patterns. Impact: sidecar process terminates unexpectedly. Race conditions occur across multiple trigger scenarios (aborted sessions, retries, disconnects). Suggested fix with code example. 1 comment confirming.

signals.topic: Infinite compaction loop drains API credits without progress when compression fails
signals.summary: The session loop in prompt.ts enters an infinite compaction loop when compaction fails to reduce context below the token limit (e.g., compression state lost, incompressible messages, compression plugin error). Each iteration makes an API call, spinning indefinitely and consuming credits with zero progress. No retry counter or break condition exists.
signals.review_reason: 明显金钱损失 + 主流程阻断：无限 compaction 循环导致持续消耗 API 积分而无任何进展，根因明确（runLoop 中无 break guard），对有压缩失效场景的用户（压缩状态丢失、不可压缩消息）直接造成经济损失。

source_issues.title: bug(session): infinite compaction loop when compression fails to reduce context
source_issues.evidence: Root cause identified in runLoop function: overflow check and compact result paths both trigger compaction.create() and continue without guard. No retry counter. Loop spins consuming API credits indefinitely. 1 comment confirming.

signals.topic: ACP mode silently drops /model and /mode commands, breaking core user commands
signals.summary: In ACP mode, OpenCode sends available_commands_update to ACP clients (e.g. OpenACP) but only includes 'compact' as hardcoded fallback. The 'model' and 'mode' commands are missing, so ACP clients that gate command dispatch on the registry silently drop these commands. This manifests as /model and /mode commands in Telegram (via OpenACP) producing no response at all.
signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：/model 和 /mode 是核心用户命令，在 ACP 模式下完全静默失效（Telegram 用户通过 OpenACP 发出 /model 命令无任何响应）。根因明确（available_commands_update 缺少注册），非单仓通用问题（仅影响 ACP 用户），优先级降为 P1。

source_issues.title: fix(acp): model and mode commands not registered in available_commands_update
source_issues.evidence: Root cause in packages/opencode/src/acp/agent.ts: available_commands_update payload only includes compact. model and mode missing. ACP clients silently drop unregistered commands. Concrete user impact: /model Telegram command via OpenACP produces no response.

signals.topic: Files list API 不支持从 Managed Agent API 列出文件（无法覆盖 beta header）
signals.summary: 用户在调用 Managed Agent API 的文件列表功能时，无法传入 `scope_id` 和特定的 `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header。SDK 在 FileServiceImpl 中硬编码了默认 beta headers，导致用户无法列出属于 managed agent 作用域的文件，且无任何 workaround。
aliases: FileServiceImpl beta header 无法覆盖
signals.review_reason: 这是一个真实用户痛点：用户在生产环境中需要使用 Managed Agent 的文件列表功能，但 SDK 层面硬编码了 beta header，导致该功能完全不可用，且没有任何 workaround 可以绕过。这是关键功能的阻断性问题，虽然 count=1 无法达到 P0 标准，但影响明确属于 P1 级别。

source_issues.title: Files list API does not support listing files from managed agent API
source_issues.evidence: 用户在 issue 中明确描述：使用 Managed Agent API 时需要传递 scope_id 和 managed-agents-2026-04-01 beta header，但 FileServiceImpl 硬编码了默认 headers，无任何方式覆盖，导致无法列出那些文件。主流程功能完全不可用。

signals.topic: Prompt caching bills 1.25x for cache-write tokens that are never read back on warm calls
signals.summary: When using explicit cache_control breakpoints, the server writes additional cache entries past the breakpoint that are billed at 1.25x but never produce cache reads on subsequent calls, contradicting documented behavior and causing direct financial loss.
signals.review_reason: Direct financial loss due to 1.25x overbilling for cache-write tokens that produce zero value. Issue reproduces consistently, contradicts documented behavior, and has no user-side workaround.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Server writes additional cache entries past explicit `cache_control` breakpoint, billing 1.25x for tokens that are never read
source_issues.evidence: Server writes ~1416 extra tokens to cache on warm calls at 1.25x rate but these are never read back on subsequent calls. Warm calls show cache_creation=1416 when they should show cache_creation=0 per docs. Direct monetary impact: users are billed 1.25x for tokens that are never utilized.

signals.topic: Tool runner loop enters infinite loop when append_messages() is called inside the loop with the official advanced usage docs example
signals.summary: Following the official 'advanced usage' docs example for tool runner causes an infinite loop because append_messages() inside the loop prevents auto-append of tool results, so the model never sees its previous tool result and re-invokes the tool forever.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow is completely blocked by following the official documentation example. Infinite loop is a severe runtime failure with no graceful error, directly breaking the tool runner use case.

source_issues.title: [Bug] append_messages() inside tool runner loop causes infinite loop (advanced usage docs example)
source_issues.evidence: Official 'advanced usage' docs example triggers infinite loop. Calling append_messages() inside the loop sets _messages_modified=True, skipping auto-append of assistant message + tool result. Next iteration sends request with no tool result in history, causing model to re-invoke the tool. Loop never terminates.

signals.topic: ServerToolResult blocks are orphaned and never delivered when client tools interrupt the stream during concurrent tool execution
signals.summary: When server-side tools (code_execution, web_search) run concurrently with client-defined tools, ServerToolResult content blocks for the server tools are never delivered to the caller — neither during streaming, in the final message, nor in subsequent API calls — leaving orphaned server_tool_use blocks.
aliases: server tool results missing from stream
ServerToolResult not delivered on tool_use stop_reason
signals.review_reason: Core workflow is broken for applications using server-side tools alongside client tools. Server tool results are silently lost with no API signal, causing stuck UI spinners and false monitoring alerts. No workaround besides heuristic cleanup assumptions.

source_issues.title: ServerToolResult not delivered when client tools interrupt the stream (code_execution + client tool concurrency)
source_issues.evidence: Production load test shows orphaned server_tool_use blocks (text_editor_code_execution, web_search) in all concurrent user tests. Stream ends before server tool results arrive, results never appear in get_final_message() or next API call. Causes frontend stuck spinners, false error detection in monitoring. 6+ months old with no resolution.

signals.topic: deepcopy_minimal in files.beta.upload mutates the caller's input dict in place, corrupting user data
signals.summary: The files.beta.upload function uses deepcopy_minimal which does not recursively copy tuples, causing the 4th element (a Mapping) of File tuples to be mutated in place and returned to the caller as corrupted data.
signals.review_reason: Silent data corruption — the caller's input object is mutated without any warning, violating the principle of least surprise. This can cause subtle, hard-to-debug failures in caller applications where state appears corrupted for no apparent reason.

source_issues.title: Use of `deepcopy_minimal` in `files.beta.upload` mutates dict in place
source_issues.evidence: User-provided File tuples containing a Mapping (4th element) are mutated in place by deepcopy_minimal after calling files.beta.upload. The headers dict component is modified and returned changed to the caller. No warning or exception is raised, silently corrupting caller state.

signals.topic: Managed Agents sessions.events.send rejects output_config/effort with 400 error — no parity with messages.create for thinking depth control
signals.summary: messages.create accepts output_config.effort for thinking depth control, but sessions.events.send (the only way to send messages to managed agents) rejects it with 400 'Extra inputs are not permitted'. Users pay 3x cost and 3.3x latency due to default high effort with no API-level workaround.
aliases: no effort/thinking control in beta sessions API
signals.review_reason: Feature parity failure causing significant cost and latency impact (3x cost, 3.3x slower by default). The only available workaround is fragile L1 prompt steering. Users following the official effort parameter docs hit a wall on managed agents.

source_issues.title: Managed Agents `sessions.events.send` rejects `output_config` with 400 — no parity with `messages.create` for effort/thinking control
source_issues.evidence: API returns HTTP 400 with 'output_config: Extra inputs are not permitted' on sessions.events.send. Sonnet 4.6 defaults to 'high' effort; medium effort reduces cost 3x ($0.31→$0.10) and latency 3.3x (156s→47s). No API-level lever exists for managed agents despite GA effort parameter on messages.create.

signals.topic: Vertex AI endpoint rejects document URL sources with misleading error path
signals.summary: When using @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk to send a document content block with a URL source, the Vertex AI endpoint rejects the request. The error message incorrectly references 'image.source.base64.data' instead of the actual 'document.source.url' path, making debugging difficult. This blocks users from using URL-sourced documents with Vertex AI despite documentation listing it as supported.
aliases: Vertex AI document URL source rejection
wrong error path for URL source documents
signals.review_reason: User reports a functional block: document URL sources (advertised as supported in docs) are rejected at the Vertex AI endpoint, with an additional compounding problem of a misleading error path (error says image.source.base64.data instead of document.source.url), which made debugging difficult. This is a main-flow failure with both documentation mismatch and confusing error messaging, directly blocking users who rely on Vertex AI document ingestion.

source_issues.title: Vertex AI: document URL sources rejected with incorrect error path
source_issues.evidence: User reports that sending a document content block with URL source to Vertex AI endpoint fails with misleading error 'messages.0.content.0.image.source.base64.data: URL sources are not supported' even though the content is a document with source type url, not an image. The documentation lists URL sources as supported, creating a mismatch between docs and reality.

signals.topic: zodOutputFormat fails at runtime when project uses zod v3
signals.summary: The zodOutputFormat helper throws a runtime error when passed a zod v3 schema, while zod v4 schemas work fine. This breaks structured output for users on zod v3.
aliases: zod v3 schema support missing in zodOutputFormat
signals.review_reason: User documents a runtime failure: zodOutputFormat throws when used with zod v3 schemas. This is a clear functional break (structured output feature unusable) for users still on zod v3. Count is 1 (single repo), so P2 is appropriate; this is not P0 due to single-issue evidence.

source_issues.title: zodOutputFormat fails when project uses zod3
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates with a minimal reproduction that zodOutputFormat(Schema3) throws a runtime error when Schema3 is a zod v3 object schema, while zodOutputFormat(Schema4) with zod v4 works without issue. Stackblitz reproduction provided.

signals.topic: TypeScript type narrowing failure on ContentBlock makes accessing .text require ts-ignore workaround
signals.summary: After updating to SDK v0.22.0, TypeScript narrows ContentBlock type incorrectly and reports 'Property text does not exist on type ContentBlock' when accessing msg.content[0].text. Users must add // @ts-ignore as a workaround.
aliases: text property type error on ContentBlock
TypeScript type error accessing message content text
signals.review_reason: Type narrowing failure on ContentBlock forces users to insert // @ts-ignore to access message content text, degrading DX significantly. While this is a TypeScript-only issue (runtime works), it is a persistent and well-documented regression since v0.22.0 with 9 comments indicating community impact. Count is 1 and it is a type-system artifact (not a runtime block), so P2 is appropriate.

source_issues.title: [Types] Error: Property 'text' does not exist on type 'ContentBlock'.
source_issues.evidence: User reports that after updating to v0.22.0, accessing msg.content[0].text produces TypeScript error TS2339: 'Property text does not exist on type ContentBlock'. Workaround of adding // @ts-ignore is required. Issue has 9 comments and is open, indicating ongoing impact across the user base. Labeled with 'code-change' suggesting this is a recognized regression.

signals.topic: SDK hangs indefinitely in non-TTY environments (CI, Docker, launchd, cron)
signals.summary: The bundled Claude binary hangs indefinitely when stdout is not a TTY (pipe, file, CI runner, Docker without -t, launchd/cron). A launchd pipeline timed out at 1800s every tick for 24+ hours.
signals.review_reason: Complete user-blocking failure in the most common production deployment scenarios (CI, Docker, headless servers). SDK hangs indefinitely with zero progress, not a timeout or graceful degradation. No recovery without external workarounds. Directly prevents completion of work.

source_issues.title: Bundled `claude` binary hangs when stdout is not a TTY (pipe / file / launchd / cron / Docker)
source_issues.evidence: Any Python script using claude_agent_sdk hangs indefinitely when stdout is a pipe or regular file. Hang persists past arbitrary timeouts. Real-world impact: launchd-driven nightly pipeline timed out at 1800s every tick for 24+ hours. No functional workaround without wrapping in 'script' command.

signals.topic: SubprocessCLITransport.close() hangs indefinitely when SIGTERM handler blocks
signals.summary: close() sends SIGTERM then calls await self._process.wait() with no timeout. When Claude Code's shutdown handler blocks (e.g., waiting for MCP server), process.wait() blocks forever. 30% of parallel jobs affected.
signals.review_reason: User-blocking failure at production scale. 30% of parallel jobs hang indefinitely after completing successfully, blocking worker processes and causing VM infra timeouts. Prevents clean shutdown of production deployments.

source_issues.title: SubprocessCLITransport.close() hangs indefinitely if subprocess shutdown handler blocks
source_issues.evidence: In use case running ~200 parallel Claude Code instances via SDK, 30% of jobs hung indefinitely. Claude Code job finished successfully but VM stayed hanging because transport.close() never returned, causing entire worker process to hit VM infra timeout.

signals.topic: Error context destroyed through exception flattening — CLI failures produce opaque exceptions
signals.summary: CLI failures produce hardcoded 'Command failed with exit code 1' instead of actual stderr. The exception chain flattens ProcessError to bare Exception, so ClaudeSDKError never fires and consumers cannot catch typed errors.
signals.review_reason: Significant debugging experience degradation making CLI failures undebugable. Users receive opaque 'Command failed with exit code 1' with no actual error output or typed exceptions. Transforms actionable failures into dead-ends, directly impeding production troubleshooting.

source_issues.title: Error context destroyed through exception flattening — CLI failures produce unhelpful 'Command failed with exit code 1'
source_issues.evidence: 3-step chain destroys error context: ProcessError created with hardcoded 'Check stderr output for details' instead of actual stderr; str(e) flattens ProcessError; re-raises as bare Exception() losing ProcessError type entirely. Consumer code catching ClaudeSDKError never fires. No actual stderr, no typed exception, no actionable detail.

signals.topic: TaskNotificationMessage fires prematurely while subagent is still executing tool calls
signals.summary: When orchestrator dispatches parallel subagents via Task tool, TaskNotificationMessage arrives 76-850 seconds early while subagent is still running. Caused wrong dispatches, 8 min wasted re-dispatching, and stale notification flooding.
signals.review_reason: Significant experience degradation in core orchestration use cases. Premature completion signals cause wrong downstream dispatches, wasted work, and cost increase. Affects the primary Task/subagent parallel execution pattern that is central to SDK usage.

source_issues.title: [Bug] TaskNotificationMessage fires while subagent is still running (premature, not cross-turn leak)
source_issues.evidence: Non-deterministic: premature notifications caused 5 reviewer subagents dispatched against non-existent output files, 8 min wasted re-dispatching all 5 researchers, 17 min of stale notifications flooding orchestrator. Total run: 32 min/$21.51 vs baseline 51 min/$22.33. 30% cost increase from wasted re-dispatch.

signals.topic: stderr callback exception silently kills stderr delivery for entire session
signals.summary: A single RuntimeError in user-provided stderr callback causes the _handle_stderr loop to terminate silently via 'except Exception: pass'. All subsequent stderr lines for the session are permanently dropped with no log or traceback.
aliases: stderr loop exit on callback error
signals.review_reason: Silent failure that permanently destroys debugging capability. One transient callback error permanently disables stderr piping for the entire session. Critical CLI errors after the first failure are completely lost with no indication. Reliability issue for production systems depending on stderr for observability.

source_issues.title: Bug: stderr callback raise silently kills _handle_stderr loop, dropping all subsequent stderr lines
source_issues.evidence: User-provided options.stderr callback raising (even once) causes _handle_stderr loop to terminate silently via 'except Exception: pass'. No log, no traceback. All subsequent stderr lines dropped for rest of session. Subsequent CLI errors that would reach user's logger are lost entirely.

signals.topic: Linux glibc 系统中 SDK 错误选择 musl 二进制文件导致 query() 完全失败
signals.summary: 当 pnpm 等包管理器同时安装了 glibc 和 musl 变体时，SDK 的二进制选择器优先尝试 musl 变体，导致在 glibc 系统（如 Ubuntu 24.04）上 spawn ENOENT 错误，且错误信息误导性地显示「binary not found」而文件实际存在。用户被迫手动指定 pathToClaudeCodeExecutable 或事后删除 musl 包目录作为临时解决方案。
aliases: musl binary picked over glibc on Linux
Linux binary resolver selects wrong libc variant
glibc vs musl binary picker failure on Linux
signals.review_reason: 3 条独立 issue 均描述完全相同的根因：Linux glibc 系统中 SDK 二进制选择器优先尝试 musl 变体，导致 query() 在 spawn 时 ENOENT 失败。主流程完全阻断——用户无法运行任何 SDK 查询会话，且错误信息具有误导性（文件存在却报 not found）。glibc Linux 是最常见的 Linux 环境，pnpm 默认行为会导致两个变体都被安装，受影响用户范围广。需要手动 pathToClaudeCodeExecutable 或 post-install 脚本作为 workaround，严重影响使用体验。

source_issues.title: Native binary resolver picks linux-x64-musl on glibc systems, ignoring the libc field
source_issues.evidence: SDK 在 glibc 系统上尝试 spawn musl 二进制，execve 失败（缺少 /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1），抛出 ENOENT，用户看到误导性的「binary not found」错误。30-50% 的缓存未命中安装会触发此问题。

source_issues.title: Binary picker selects musl variant on glibc Linux, causing ENOENT at spawn
source_issues.evidence: musl 可选依赖未声明 libc 字段，npm/pnpm 在 glibc 主机上同时安装两个变体；运行期选择器按错误顺序尝试变体，spawn 失败。

source_issues.title: Linux: musl binary preferred over glibc in v0.2.116 CLI auto-discovery
source_issues.evidence: 复现于 Ubuntu 24.04 (glibc 2.39) + pnpm 10.32.1 + SDK 0.2.116。glibc 变体二进制实际存在且可执行，musl 变体二进制在磁盘存在但无法执行（缺少动态链接器）。spawn 失败后未触发 fallback 迭代。

signals.topic: createSdkMcpServer 对嵌套 Zod 字段 .describe() 和 registerTool 延迟注册的工具描述不进行回填
signals.summary: SDK 的 MCP 服务器工具注册逻辑对顶级 shape 值做了 description 回填，但未递归处理嵌套属性，且 createSdkMcpServer 调用之后通过 registerTool 添加的工具也无法获得描述回填，导致工具提示词和参数描述丢失，用户无法了解工具的正确用法。
aliases: Zod .describe() dropped for nested fields in MCP server
tool description not backfilled for deferred tool registration
signals.review_reason: 嵌套 Zod 字段描述和延迟注册工具描述丢失，直接影响 MCP 工具的可用性——用户在运行时无法通过 LLM 理解工具参数语义，降低工具使用准确性。虽然仅 1 条 issue，但提供了完整的复现代码和根因分析，缺陷明确，且属于 MCP 服务器这一核心功能的正确性问题。

source_issues.title: createSdkMcpServer drops Zod v4 field .describe() if nested or added after via registerTool
source_issues.evidence: 顶级 Zod .describe() 能正确回填，但嵌套字段（如 z.object({ followUp: z.string().describe('description dropped') })）的描述被丢弃；createSdkMcpServer 调用之后通过 registerTool 添加的工具描述同样丢失。根因代码为单层 for 循环无递归。

signals.topic: npm 包 package.json 缺少 repository 字段导致 Renovate/Dependabot 无法获取变更日志和 Release Notes
signals.summary: 发布的 npm 包中 repository 字段为 null，导致 Renovate 和 Dependabot 在依赖更新 PR 中无法嵌入变更日志和 Release Notes。对于每天发布新版本的 SDK，下游用户只能盲目审批自动化 PR，显著增加维护负担。
aliases: Renovate/Dependabot cannot discover changelogs for SDK updates
signals.review_reason: repository 字段缺失是明确的可重现问题，导致依赖管理自动化 PR 缺失变更日志。对于高频发布（每天）的 SDK，下游用户在 Renovate PR 中无法获得变更信息，只能盲审，显著增加维护成本。虽仅 1 条 issue 但影响所有依赖该 SDK 的下游项目，是可信的痛点。

source_issues.title: Set `repository` field in package.json so Renovate/Dependabot can find release notes
source_issues.evidence: curl 验证 registry.npmjs.org 显示 repository: null。Renovate 的 changelog 发现逻辑读取 repository 字段，不回退到 homepage；Dependabot 同样从中解析源码仓库。每 PR 无变更日志意味着下游用户盲审，增加维护认知负担。

signals.topic: Symlink ENOENT crash during sensitive-file config restoration (cpSync fails when SENSITIVE_PATHS entries are symlinks)
signals.summary: cpSync in restoreConfigFromBase crashes with ENOENT when any SENSITIVE_PATHS entry (e.g. CLAUDE.md) is a git-tracked symlink, because cpSync defaults to dereference:false and tries to recreate the symlink target at .claude-pr/ without the parent directory existing. Affects PRs whose head contains a symlinked CLAUDE.md.
signals.review_reason: Main-flow blocker: symlink dereference bug crashes the action before Claude Code can run, 100% reproducible for any PR with a symlinked SENSITIVE_PATHS entry. Count=3 with consistent ENOENT evidence across all three reports confirming the crash. Despite count<3, the P0 designation is warranted because (a) it is a deterministic main-flow failure, (b) the error message is opaque to users, and (c) no workaround exists for repos using symlinked CLAUDE.md.

source_issues.title: cpSync crashes with ENOENT when sensitive paths are symlinks
source_issues.evidence: Since v1.0.89, action crashes during restoreConfigFromBase with ENOENT: no such file or directory, symlink when SENSITIVE_PATHS entries are symlinks. cpSync dereference:false tries to recreate the symlink at .claude-pr/ without the parent dir existing. 100% reproducible.

source_issues.title: cpSync fails on symlinked sensitive files
source_issues.evidence: When CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md, every Code Review run fails with the same ENOENT crash. 100% reproducible, not intermittent.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase crashes with ENOENT when only CLAUDE.md exists (cpSync needs mkdir of .claude-pr/ first)
source_issues.evidence: Action crashes with ENOENT on any PR whose head has CLAUDE.md but no .claude/ directory. The cpSync path tries to write to .claude-pr/ when the parent doesn't exist, blocking the entire action.

signals.topic: GitHub Copilot bot actor causes 404 errors in actor/permission checks, blocking allowed_bots from working
signals.summary: checkHumanActor and checkWritePermissions both call GitHub APIs with the literal username 'Copilot', which returns 404 because there is no resolvable GitHub user under that login. The [bot] suffix bypass exists but 'Copilot' does not match it, so the action fails for any Copilot-SWE-agent-triggered workflow even when Copilot is listed in allowed_bots.
signals.review_reason: Count=3 covering all three affected code paths (checkHumanActor, checkWritePermissions, and the allowed_bots interaction gap). All three are confirmed 404 crashes that prevent bot-actor workflows from running at all. Main-flow failure with no workaround for users who want to use Copilot SWE agents alongside allowed_bots.

source_issues.title: Action fails with 'Not Found' when triggered by GitHub Copilot (actor Copilot returns 404 from /users/ API)
source_issues.evidence: checkHumanActor passes 'Copilot' directly to GET /users/{username}, which returns 404. Action crashes before any Claude Code execution, even when Copilot is listed in allowed_bots.

source_issues.title: allowed_bots bypasses actor check but not permission check — bot actors still fail with 404
source_issues.evidence: allowed_bots bypasses checkHumanActor but NOT checkWritePermissions. When Copilot triggers pull_request_review, the action fails with 404 from the collaborators API because bot accounts are not repository collaborators.

source_issues.title: checkWritePermissions fails with 404 for non-user actors like 'Copilot'
source_issues.evidence: checkWritePermissions calls getCollaboratorPermissionLevel with github.actor='Copilot', which returns 404. The [bot] suffix bypass exists on line 47 but 'Copilot' does not match that pattern.

signals.topic: claude-code-review.yml has two recurring failure modes causing ~70% review failure rate on otherwise-passing PRs
signals.summary: Two deterministic failure modes in the code-review workflow: (Mode A) gh pr view is called without --repo flag, causing 'no default remote repository' errors when the working directory is not the repo root; (Mode B) haiku deduplication produces false positives causing incorrect review behavior. Combined effect is ~70% failure rate on otherwise valid PRs across multiple runs.
aliases: claude-code-review workflow gh pr view no --repo
haiku dedup false positive code review
signals.review_reason: High failure rate (70%) across PRs demonstrated in a single repo over a short time window. The gh pr view --repo issue is a clear code path defect that causes silent failure (action exits non-zero, no review posted) despite all prior steps succeeding. The haiku dedup false-positive is a logic bug producing incorrect review content. Combined, this is a significant degradation of the core code-review use case.

source_issues.title: claude-code-review.yml has two recurring failure modes (Mode A: gh CLI invocation; Mode B: haiku dedup false-positive)
source_issues.evidence: Across PRs #62-#74 in a single repo, ~70% review failure rate on otherwise-passing PRs. Mode A: gh pr view called without --repo in some code paths, causing 'no default remote repository' error. Mode B: haiku dedup produces false positives. Both are deterministic and reproducible.

signals.topic: Action requests endpoints requiring write permissions, but fine-grained PATs with minimal perms are denied
signals.summary: Users with fine-grained PATs configured with minimal permissions get 'Permission denied' errors during action setup. The action appears to use endpoints that require more permissions than documented, and/or undocumented permission requirements cause the action to fail for users who configured PATs conservatively.
signals.review_reason: Main-flow blocker: inability to use fine-grained PATs forces users to use broader-scope tokens, which is a security regression for enterprise users who intentionally restrict token scope. Even at count=1, this is a clear authentication/permission failure that prevents the action from functioning for affected users, warranting P1.

source_issues.title: Permission denied for Claude Code Action with fine-grained PAT
source_issues.evidence: User configured fine-grained PAT with read Contents/PRs/Workflows and write Contents (for push), plus GraphQL API read access. Action still fails with permission error during setup, indicating undocumented endpoint requirements exceed the stated minimum permissions.

signals.topic: Action intermittently posts repository's CLAUDE.md verbatim as PR comment instead of structured code review
signals.summary: The action intermittently echoes the repository's CLAUDE.md file verbatim as the PR comment body instead of producing the structured review the workflow's prompt requests. The action exits with conclusion: success, so the CI check is green, but no actual review is performed — PR authors receive no useful feedback.
aliases: CLAUDE.md verbatim post instead of review
signals.review_reason: Core code-review use case silently fails: action reports success but produces no review content, leaving PR authors without feedback. The green CI check misleads maintainers into believing a review was performed. This is a critical false-positive outcome for a review tool, as it hides the failure from users. P1 despite count=1 because it corrupts the primary deliverable of the action.

source_issues.title: Action posts repo's CLAUDE.md verbatim as comment body instead of structured review (workflow exits success)
source_issues.evidence: Same workflow ran on two consecutive commits of the same PR. First run: normal structured review. Second run: CLAUDE.md echoed verbatim as comment, action exited success. No review content produced despite green CI check.

signals.topic: API 400 error 'messages: text content blocks must be non-empty' caused by empty text blocks in conversation history, blocks all interactions
signals.summary: Conversation history accumulates empty text content blocks (likely from empty tool results), causing every subsequent API call to return 400 invalid_request_error. The main workflow is completely blocked — user cannot use Claude Code at all once the corruption occurs. The suggested fix is to start a new session, losing all history.
aliases: text content blocks must be non-empty API error
signals.review_reason: Main flow completely blocked: once empty text blocks accumulate in conversation history, every API call fails with 400. User cannot continue any work — only workaround is starting a new session (losing all history). Two reporters (macOS, Windows) with the same root cause (empty tool results in history). Appears spontaneously during normal use.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Empty text content blocks in messages
source_issues.evidence: API returns 400 with 'messages: text content blocks must be non-empty'. Multiple consecutive errors in stream output. Blocks all model interactions.

source_issues.title: [BUG] API Error 400
source_issues.evidence: API 400 error 'messages: text content blocks must be non-empty'. Appears randomly during conversation, no specific trigger. Blocks all Claude Code interactions.

signals.topic: `claude respawn` silently fails on background sessions hitting 'request too large' — context overflow not handled, session never restarts
signals.summary: When background sessions accumulate context and hit 'request too large', `claude respawn` reports success (exit 0) but the session state never transitions back to running. Only `claude rm + claude --bg` recovers, losing conversation history. Affects daemon-supervised agent fleets with cron-driven long-running sessions.
signals.review_reason: Main workflow blocked: long-running daemon sessions become permanently unrecoverable via respawn. Silent failure (exit 0 but no actual restart) means users don't know their session is dead until they inspect state.json manually. 8 reproducible instances over 48 hours across a 9-agent fleet. Loss of conversation history on workaround is significant.

source_issues.title: `claude respawn` silently fails on background sessions that hit "request too large" — only nuclear `claude rm + claude --bg` recovers (loses conversation)
source_issues.evidence: 9 sub-agent sessions on Windows, reproducible across 8 separate sessions over 48 hours. `claude respawn` returns exit 0 but state.json stays 'stopped' indefinitely. Workaround loses all conversation history.

signals.topic: Session registry file written non-atomically on Windows — crash mid-write produces all-null JSON, entire session vanishes from all UI surfaces
